name: Georgia Envirothon
org: Georgia Envirothon (Georgia Soil and Water Conservation Commission and partners)
what_you_do: Teams of 4 to 6 students learn about wildlife, forests, water life, soil and land use. They also study a current issue. Then they compete at a state contest with field tests and a talk.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school teams of 4 to 6 students. The page does not give grade rules.
pay_detail: $250 registration fee per team. Lunch is included.
deadline_text: Training day Oct 28, 2026 (Eastanollee, GA). Competition registration deadline March 20, 2027. Competition April 27, 2027 at Tugaloo State Park.
how_to_apply: Go to the Resources tab of the Georgia Envirothon site. Use the sign-up section.
notes: Late registration may mean no lunch count or no team shirt. The page also lists October 9, 2026 as a training day registration date.
